note: EXP-10 (research/experiments/EXP-10-variant-stream-slot.md): does a variant record that keeps all of URB_Bar's streams (CIN_DropshipIntros, patch_bar, patch_hide_randomized_objects) and adds an edit patch built on an empty template in a free slot load, and stream every one of them? The patch starts from an empty map (base ""), not patch_bar, so patch_bar's actors come only from patch_bar's own stream. URB_Bar ships as URB_BarSlot (map.shipAs), with a record of its own that streams the patch in the lowest StreamingMaps slot URB_Bar's record does not use (map.streamSlot "free": slot 2). Two visible CoverPatch.High2x2 blocks make a 2x4 wall in front of the dumpsters, over URB_Bar tiles x 1-2, y 9-12: EXP-04's block (tile 2,10; in game on 3 Nov 2026) and exp04b's second block right south of it, turned 90 degrees. seed false keeps the stream layout the only new factor: the blocks stand on ground-level tiles, as EXP-04's did without seeds.
